notes: The supplied so* is read as the additive καί's alongside its own and, headed on and; marking it `added` under rule 103 — so standing for the spent predicate μάρτυρες — is a materially defensible competing reading and should be recorded as such.
The supplied is* goes to the subject noun πνεῦμα under rule 56, the Greek clause expressing no predicate of its own.
Three articles emptied: one by the attributive demonstrative (rule 38), the second attributive article (rule 23), and the one before an undetermined God (rule 23).
